title: Group Shifted Strings
statement_md: We can shift a string by shifting each of its letters to its successive letter. Given an array of strings `strings`, group all strings that belong to the same shifting sequence.
hints: Use difference between consecutive characters as key.
editorial_md:
### Method: Hash Map with Difference Key
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N \cdot K)$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N \cdot K)$
